correctness.rationale: For every n>=1 the canonical signed partition decomposes uniquely into zero size b and ordered ordinary blocks of sizes s_i with q_i negative nonminimum letters. There are C(n-1,b-1) prod_i C(n-a_(i-1)-1,s_i-1) C(s_i-1,q_i) such partitions. The cited word bijection gives exact descents 2b-1 (if b>1), 2a_(i-1)+2q_i (if q_i>0), and 2a_i-1 (if s_i-q_i>1); all joins are ascents/non-descents. Hence the positive sum and run-composition formula follow without extrapolation. The O(n^3) extraction has n suffix states and O(r^2) block transitions per state. Direct unrestricted Stirling insertion and independent shape enumeration agree for all n<=8, run marginals match the 2023 table through n=10, the optimized DP agrees with all exact n<=8 descent profiles, and verify.py returned VERIFY_OK.

originality.rationale: The result refines the exact POSITION SET of descents and all ordered run-length compositions. Buck et al. 2023 prove the underlying type-B bijection and pose equal-run-length enumeration as Open Problem 3, but give no full position-set coefficient formula. Shankar 2023 proves an all-multiplicity descent-NUMBER EGF and maximum-run formula, which aggregate different position sets and do not determine individual exact compositions. Previous internal flattened-parking-function work treats a distinct word family. Residual possibility of unindexed equivalent formulas remains.

value.rationale: The complete ordered run-length distribution of a natural word class is a meaningful refinement beyond known one-variable descent counts. In particular the uniformly specified formula solves the equal-length-run enumeration requested as Open Problem 3 by Buck et al. for every admissible n,d. The O(n^3) exact extraction gives scalable direct computation for any one profile rather than enumeration of all Stirling permutations. It is not a single arbitrary slice or mere recomputation of the known Dowling totals.
